partners.mechanism_chain: CTNNA1 (HGNC:2186) —DISRUPTS→ E-cadherin mediated cell adhesion (GO:0007156); E-cadherin mediated cell adhesion (GO:0007156) —LEADS_TO→ Patterned macular dystrophy (HP:0030070); CDON (HGNC:2379) —DISRUPTS→ Cell adhesion and cell migration in neuronal development (GO:0007155); Cell adhesion and cell migration in neuronal development (GO:0007155) —LEADS_TO→ Holoprosencephaly (HP:0001361); E-cadherin mediated cell adhesion (GO:0007156) —BINDS→ Cell adhesion signaling in neuronal development (None); Cell adhesion and cell migration in neuronal development (GO:0007155) —BINDS→ Cell adhesion signaling in neuronal development (None).
